message.content: {"label":"Negative","rationale":"Clause 4’s overtime duty is displaced by Clause 5 because the extra hours were worked voluntarily (F5). The salary-threshold provision also states that overtime is not required (C3; F3). Although the emergency provision could require payment, it is subject to Clause 6, and equivalent time off was granted (C7; C6; F6).","source_ids":["C3","C4","C5","C6","C7","F3","F5","F6"]}
